name: @edam/anchor-proof
description: Pure RFC-3161 + RFC-6962 (transparency-log) anchor-proof primitives (EDAM @edam/anchor-proof): canonical TstInfo/STH signing bytes, Merkle leaf/node/tree/inclusion hashing, and the offline token verifiers (verifyRfc3161Token / verifyTransparencyLogToken). Shared by the anchoring providers (build) and the independent verifier (check) so there is ONE implementation and no builder<->verifier drift. Pure; depends only on @edam/canonical + node:crypto. No services / WORM / signing-private / DB.
